sketches.mechanism: Nontermination is bottom, a value that can inhabit any type because it never produces a concrete value.
sketches.resonance: It can promise to become anything only by never arriving.

sketches.mechanism: A subtype range constraint raises Constraint_Error when an assigned value falls outside the declared bounds.
sketches.resonance: A world typed to contain only today cannot accept tomorrow.

sketches.mechanism: Assigning nil to a table key removes the entry because nil represents absence rather than a stored value.
sketches.resonance: Forgetting is not kept anywhere; it is the place where something stops being there.
